name: local
description: Private local plugins for Chris Weber

plugins.name: ideate
plugins.description: Pre-work ideation with a visual decision canvas. Generates divergent ideas, launches a local web UI for annotation, then synthesizes decisions into a concrete plan

plugins.name: admin
plugins.description: Plugin, agent, and skill management tooling: bump-version, scaffold, new-agent, new-skill, optimize-agents, update-plugins, create-worktree

plugins.name: drupal-lab
plugins.description: Drupal-specific development skills and agents (DDEV, Analysis, Validation, Scaffolding)

plugins.name: lib
plugins.description: CLI wrapper skills: Slack, Jira, GitHub, TestRail, vault operations, log analysis, and file utilities

plugins.name: workshop
plugins.description: Process automation skills: prioritize, scout, knowledge-check, deploy checklist, Obsidian maintenance, and personal productivity

plugins.name: drover
plugins.description: Drupal and Acquia log evidence: pulls application logs, groups and diagnoses recurring errors, and renders monthly stakeholder and operational reports with an evidence file for follow-up.

plugins.name: research-lab
plugins.description: Knowledge-work verbs as standalone compositional primitives: frame, gather, understand, synthesize, interrogate, experiment, teach. NotebookLM + Workflow fan-out; preflight-first input contracts; no orchestrator

plugins.name: process-lab
plugins.description: Holds agent-assisted work to each project's own process. Reads the project's workflow from its Confluence page, notices when work crosses a step, records what the process requires and whether it was done or waived, and runs retrospectives against it.

plugins.name: ideas-funnel
plugins.description: Passive knowledge capture pipeline — Karpathy-derived LLM Wiki with Monitor-driven multi-domain ingest. Feeds land in raw/, agents compile them into a cross-linked Obsidian wiki, memory evolves via confidence decay and graph-aware consolidation.

plugins.name: design-lab
plugins.description: Build and maintain a verified Figma component library from real code. Resumable, schema-validated extraction and planning; Figma is one renderer.

plugins.name: test-lab
plugins.description: Convert a manual test corpus into an automated Playwright suite, and measure accessibility and performance: pluggable source, authoring methodology, and a per-story conversion skill

plugins.name: golden-rule
plugins.description: Main is never the operating surface: a mod that keeps every write out of <project>/worktrees/main (sandboxed shell, guarded edits, fail-closed) and sends changes through feature worktrees and pull requests
